title: Rolling cross-asset relative-value convergence in fixed economic pairs

data.signal_interval: 4h aggregated from 48 complete 5m bars aligned to UTC
inputs: mark price klines for funding valuation
data.quality_policy: fail before PnL on corrupt ZIP, hash mismatch, invalid or duplicate row, non-contiguous 5m series, incomplete 4h aggregation, missing archive, or missing signal, execution, or funding valuation data
data.boundary_note: all observations end before the 2026-07-30 forward boundary and remain D0 development evidence

signal.beta_model: OLS with intercept of y 4h close-to-close log returns on x returns using only the prior 540 complete 4h bars
signal.spread: log(y close) minus frozen beta times log(x close)
signal.center_and_scale: mean and sample standard deviation of spread levels over the same prior 540 bars, excluding the current signal bar
signal.direction: when y residual is rich, short y and long beta-weighted x; when y residual is cheap, long y and short beta-weighted x
signal.decision_time: close of the complete 4h signal bar
signal.base_entry_time: 5m open after one full post-signal 5m processing bar, exactly 5 minutes after the next 4h boundary
signal.exit: first later complete 4h close whose frozen-beta spread crosses the frozen entry center, otherwise seven calendar days after entry
signal.base_exit_time: 5m open after one full post-exit-signal 5m processing bar; maximum-hold exit is exactly seven days after entry
signal.overlap: at most one open trade per fixed pair; a pair must re-enter absolute rolling zscore at or below 1 before another entry

risk_and_capacity.allocation_reason: four fixed pairs each receive at most one quarter of account gross, so simultaneous signals cannot exceed one unit of gross exposure
risk_and_capacity.leg_weights: within each pair, absolute y weight to absolute x weight is 1 to beta and the two absolute weights sum to 0.25
risk_and_capacity.capacity_measure: minimum quote volume of the 12 completed 5m bars ending at the signal close
risk_and_capacity.capacity_rule: reference account notional times absolute leg weight must not exceed 2% of that leg's capacity measure; otherwise skip the signal

execution.delay_rule: delay5m moves both pair legs at entry and exit by one additional complete 5m bar
execution.fees: charge each x and y entry and exit fill notional
execution.funding: include every actual funding transfer with leg_entry_time <= funding_time < leg_exit_time, valued at the mark-price 5m open at funding_time
execution.live_authorization: PAPER_ONLY; no live orders are authorized

interpretation.pass: eligible only for point-in-time pair-universe replication, cointegration diagnostics and sub-minute execution replay; not eligible for live trading
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any pair list, lookback, zscore, rearm level, beta range, allocation, or holding-period change requires a new experiment id
interpretation.prohibited_claim: independent out-of-sample profitability or live-trading value
interpretation.known_bias: the four economic pairs and their surviving contracts are fixed with hindsight and cannot support a deployable universe claim
interpretation.independence_rule: each pair trade is one observation; trades sharing an entry UTC day are additionally treated as one dependent event cluster
interpretation.anti_concentration_rule: a passing result cannot derive more than 40% of all positive pair contribution from one pair
